objective: one-engineered-feature-at-a-time ablation compared with same-architecture baseline
training: Adam; sparse categorical crossentropy; dropout .25; dense 32; batch 64; max 100 epochs; patience 15 on validation macro-F1
selection: validation macro-F1 only; final model refit on train+validation at selected epoch
preprocessing: feature-wise StandardScaler fit on training sequences for validation selection, then refit on train+validation for test
